bagPolicy.summary: Only clear plastic or vinyl totes up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches or nonclear clutches up to 6 × 9 inches are permitted.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: General parking comes with the ticket; Premier and VIP parking are upgrades. Oversized vehicles must use the designated lot and purchase a $150 oversized vehicle pass; no overnight parking is allowed.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue visit guide does not state a designated rideshare pickup or drop-off point.

concessions.summary: Food and drinks are sold inside. One person may bring food in a clear bag of no more than one gallon and an empty soft-sided bottle or up to one gallon of water in a factory-sealed bottle.
allowed: Food in a clear one-gallon bag
Sealed water up to one gallon
